artworks.title: A War Memorial
artworks.artist: John Singer Sargent
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper mounted on board
artworks.description: “This painting shows a pathway lined with short pillars and steps adorned with red flags on the left side and a tree-filled area on the right. The leaves overhead cast dappled shadows on the tan ground. The sky behind the brown tree branches is light blue. The brushstrokes in the painting are loose and impressionistic.”

artworks.title: Satyr
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau the Elder after René Michel Slodtz after Annibale Carracci
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection, in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper torso and head. The person is in a twisting pose with their left arm resting on an architectural element. Their head is turned to the right, looking upward. The person has a bearded chin, a broad nose, wide eyes, and an open mouth. Their hair is curly and adorned with leaves or foliage. They are draped in a textured garment made of animal fur. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background includes stone columns, a plinth, and text on the left. The setting appears classical or ancient.

artworks.title: Academy
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure lying on his back with his legs raised and bent at the knees. His arms are positioned to the sides, one slightly bent upwards and the other laid outwards. The figure's head is resting on a pillow, turned to the right, with long hair flowing down. The person appears to be unclothed on a textured surface. The background is plain with shading and stippling, but no specific environmental details are visible.

artworks.title: Academy
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a man seated with his back facing the viewer. He is in a seated pose with one leg extended forward and the other leg bent. He leans slightly backward and supports his body with one hand on the surface behind him. The man has short wavy hair and is turning his head slightly to the side, showing his facial features in profile. He does not appear to be wearing any clothing or jewelry. The background is a soft, shaded area that outlines the figure, focusing on the man's form. At the bottom of the artwork, there are inscriptions: "Carle Vanloo f." and "Demarteau l.' Anc."

artworks.title: Academy
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manne printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a nude male figure seated with his right leg bent and resting on his left knee. His torso is slightly angled forward, and he rests his hands on his right knee. His head is tilted downward, looking to his left. The man's facial features are defined, with a strong jawline and prominent cheekbones. He has short, wavy hair that is neatly styled. The background is textured, emphasizing the contours of his musculature. He is seated on draped fabric, and the image is rendered in a monochromatic sepia tone. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects held by the figure.

artworks.title: Académie (457)
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure laying down. The person is reclining on his right side, with his right arm extended outward and head resting against the arm, facing downwards towards the surface. His left arm extends outwards, with his left leg bent slightly at the knee and the right leg extended back. The individual's hair appears short and wavy, and his facial features are not fully visible due to the angle of his head. No clothing or jewelry is visible, and the figure is drawn with a strong emphasis on musculature and form. The background of the image is composed of diagonal lines that create a textured pattern, giving a sense of depth and contrast to the figure's pose.

artworks.title: Academie (639)
artworks.artist: Gilles-Antoine Demarteau after Edme Bouchardon
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a reclining human figure drawn with anatomical accuracy. The person is lying on their back, with their torso angled slightly upward and legs bent at the knees. The head is turned away, hiding the facial features. The musculature and contours of the body are detailed with shading, emphasizing the human form. The surroundings include a textured surface, potentially a fabric, adding to the interplay of light and shadow. There are no visible accessories or held objects, and the background has a subtle pattern for a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: Academy (642)
artworks.artist: Gilles-Antoine Demarteau after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a nude male figure in an artistic pose. He is standing with his legs crossed, weight on his back leg, front leg bent. His torso twists to the right, arms extended forward and angled leftward. His head is tilted slightly back and turned towards his left shoulder. The man has strong facial features and an intense expression, wavy hair falling around his head. The background has evenly spaced lines creating a textured effect, in warm sepia shades. No clothing, jewelry, or additional objects are present.

artworks.title: Academy (679)
artworks.artist: Gilles-Antoine Demarteau after Jean-Jacques-François Le Barbier
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude male figure standing in a contrapposto position. The figure is facing away from the viewer, with the left arm bent across the chest and the right arm partially visible. The head is turned slightly to the left, showing the profile of the face with a jawline and curly hair close to the scalp. The background is a soft, textured surface with a gradient effect from dark to light. The figure is on a slightly rounded floor, implying a pedestal or platform.

artworks.title: Perseus and Andromeda
artworks.artist: attributed to Bartolommeo Gagliardo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures. One figure is restrained and the other is wielding a weapon, confronting a serpentine creature emerging from turbulent waters. The drawing features a composition with dynamic movement, shown through curved lines of the bodies and creature's form. Bold, fluid ink strokes and a wash add depth and texture to the forms. The background includes loose, sketchy elements possibly representing rocky terrain and chaos around the scene.

artworks.title: Charles Pierre Colardeau
artworks.artist: Thérèse-Éléonore Lingée after Louis Rolland Trinquesse
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 21.2 x 15.1 cm (8 3/8 x 5 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length profile portrait of a man facing right. His head and upper torso are visible, revealing his facial features, including a defined nose and prominent chin. He has white, styled hair in an 18th-century fashion. The man wears formal attire, consisting of a high-collared shirt with embroidery and a jacket. There are no visible accessories. The portrait is enclosed in an oval medallion with a decorative circular border. Below the medallion is an engraved plaque with the name Charles Pierre Colardeau against a textured background.

artworks.title: Nude Dancer
artworks.artist: Ernst Ludwig Kirchner
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on buff paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew Robison, in honor of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: This print shows bold, curving lines surrounding a central rectangle which encloses the black silhouette of a person with their legs bent and arms raised. Their bent knees are high, and their body is so close to the ground they are almost sitting. Their feet are in the bottom corners of the rectangle, while their hands are in the top corners. The black silhouette is set against white paper, and the borders of the rectangle are made of white and black lines. The swirling shapes that surround the central rectangle resemble stylized waves or curls with circles cut from them, and these shapes are in white against a black background.

artworks.title: Côte Sainte-Catherine, à Rouen
artworks.artist: Camille Pissarro
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane Atlas

artworks.title: Baigneuses luttant (Bathers Wrestling)
artworks.artist: Camille Pissarro
artworks.medium: lithograph with chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane Atlas

artworks.title: Market at Pontoise (Marché à Pontoise)
artworks.artist: Camille Pissarro
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane Atlas

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: Bartholomäus Ignaz Weiss
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash, heightened in white and pink gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with three figures: a man, a woman, and an infant. The man stands slightly to the left, the woman is seated, and the infant is held between them. The man has curly hair and a beard, wearing a loose garment. The woman has long facial features, wearing a headscarf and draped garment. The infant faces forward with outstretched arms. The setting is suggested to be traditional or historical, with expressive lines and a simple blue backdrop. In the top right corner, there is a smaller sketch of a female bust. The scene is depicted in soft dark shades, resembling a sketch or study, with undefined backgrounds.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: Bartholomäus Ignaz Weiss
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash, heightened in white and pink gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures, all of whom are depicted with their full bodies visible. The central figure is a seated woman with long hair and distinct facial features, such as a delicate nose and calm expression, while her head is covered with a draped fabric. Beside her is a bearded man standing close to her, with a cloak draped over his shoulder. In the woman’s lap sits a young child, reaching out with a joyful expression and curly hair, completely naked. Surrounding the figures is a simplified background, containing faint lines and shapes suggesting an interior space with minimal detail.

artworks.title: A Rococo Garden Trellis and Gazebo
artworks.artist: Jean-François de Cuvilliés I
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a complex arrangement of flowing curves and ornate lines in an abstract architectural composition. The shapes resemble elaborate garden trellises and floral embellishments, akin to large decorative arches in classical gardens. Detailed patterns suggest foliage, with leaves and tendrils weaving through the design, while the base is decorated with shell-like motifs. The curved forms on either side of the structure resemble the bodies of peacocks. Ornamental columns and arches enhance the overall grandeur, conveying a sense of a luxurious outdoor space.

artworks.title: An Elegant Lady of the Eighteenth Century Holding a Fan
artworks.artist: Carl Larsson
artworks.medium: charcoal on light brown paper, laid down on board
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a person seated in a chair, seen from the back. The person's head is turned slightly to the left, with their hair styled in a bun tied with a ribbon. They are wearing a long, flowing garment with loose sleeves, and their left arm rests on the chair's backrest. The chair is intricately designed, and there are no visible accessories or objects. The background is a plain, light brown paper, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.artist: Friedrich Sustris
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in the foreground. The figure on the left is a partially nude male kneeling with crossed arms. The second figure sits on rocks, holding a stick and extending an arm towards the first figure. Other figures in the scene include a winged figure, a woman holding a child, and a small child. The background features rocks, trees, and additional figures engaged in various activities. The style is sketch-like with shading and outlines.

artworks.title: Bust of a Woman in an Extravagant Costume
artworks.artist: French 16th Century after René Boyvin or Pierre Milan
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a composite figure with two conjoined faces, one feminine and the other masculine. The figure is adorned with various organic and artistic elements such as leaves, flowers, fruits, and a lion. The intricate details include textures of flowers, a flowing beard, and ornate fabric. The profile is framed by natural elements and stylized attire, showcasing detailed line work and shading techniques.

artworks.title: The Scales of Marriage
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Karel van Mander I
artworks.medium: engraving and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several figures dressed in detailed period clothing. One central seated figure holds a small chest or box and wears a ruffled collar, an elaborate hairstyle, and a hat. Surrounding this figure are others also dressed in historical clothing, with feathered hats, cloaks, and puffed sleeves. A cherub-like figure stands on the right holding a staff or rod. The background features a patterned floor, a brick wall, wooden beams, and scales. In the foreground, there are objects like scales and cylindrical items on the ground.

artworks.title: The Bagpipe Must Be Filled
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Karel van Mander I
artworks.medium: engraving and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features three figures seated at a table. They are positioned closely together. The person on the right is playing a bagpipe, the middle person has their hands resting on their lap, and the person on the left is holding a jug. The figures have distinct facial features with pronounced noses and expressive mouths. They all wear hats that cover their hair. The clothing is loose and textured, typical of peasant attire, with long sleeves and tunics. A dog is lying in the foreground. In the background, there is a small window with a figure looking out, trees, and a building resembling a church. Details on the table include a knife and a napkin or cloth.

artworks.title: The Wisdom of Fools
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Karel van Mander I
artworks.medium: engraving and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays four individuals seated together, with only their upper bodies primarily visible. The figures are grouped closely, with two people leaning forward while another sits back slightly, appearing engaged with the rest. The individual in the center right is wearing a headpiece and glasses, and his facial features are exaggerated with a prominent nose and open mouth. Next to him, another person wears a similar headcover and is leaning in, grasping a stick or small animal. A third figure appears to be cradling a child-like figure at the center of the group. The fourth figure on the left holds an owl. All are dressed in historical or fantastical garments with draped fabric and some ornamental headwear. In the background, there are trees with dense foliage, alongside what appears to be a body of water.
